scope: Personal-request handoff to director and recovery from unsaved local training preparation in autonomous DEMO
implemented: Current request saves/navigation flush only preparation owned by its tenant, user and request; other pending input is retained.
Reopening the same preparation replaces a detached failed callback after restoring its candidate; simultaneous inline/modal owners are prevented.
A failed preparation produces an addressed error: the repair action opens the exact result/calendar and focuses its save retry without applying an exam result.
Transfer is the primary action; preview is secondary; successful validation describes the actual next step separately from approval and signing.

browser.environment: Disposable PostgreSQL/API, synthetic tenants and Chromium desktop/390px
browser.fullPipeline: OPERATOR validates and submits 3 passed courses / 6 exact document assignments; DIRECTOR reviews and approves; OPERATOR generates 6 real PDFs in AWAITING_SIGNATURE.
browser.recovery: Green validation followed by localStorage failure blocks transfer before POST; repair focuses the exact saved candidate, inline/modal roundtrip retains one owner, retry saves without applying outcomes, COMPANY and PERSON then transfer.
browser.existingRegressions: Commission repair in current page/settings, unknown accepted response recovery without duplicate, accepted submit plus failed refresh, and addressed data repair.

serverProbes.scope: Isolated real DB: PERSON 3/6 handoff/approval/issuance, concurrent identical submits use one proposal, stale revision fails then current-revision retry succeeds.

verification.visualReview: Mobile primary transfer, submitted state, addressed preparation failure/repair, and six rendered originals awaiting signatures inspected.
verification.buildEnvironment: Windows local production build in separate .next-transfer-final-build with DEMO_STANDALONE=0; deployment configuration unchanged.

productionCheck.initialRead: Actual PERSON request was DRAFT, revision 18, approval null; server validation valid with 6 documents, 3 protocols, no issues.
productionCheck.frontendDryRun: One intercepted click formed expectedRevision 18 and exact six assignment IDs; no business write forwarded during dry run.
productionCheck.originalReportedError: NOT_REPRODUCED. Actual live transfer succeeded; no claim that an original server exception was identified.
productionCheck.businessChange: The user's existing ready request was submitted for director review; no approval, issuance or signature performed in production.
